metadata.question: Was the mean NDSI for Mount Fuji lower in December 2020 than December 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Mount Fuji, Japan (approximately 35.36°N, 138.73°E) - Collections: Sentinel-2 SR (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) or Landsat 8/9 - Dates: December 2019 and December 2020 - NDSI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds since we want to measure snow cover accurately - Use QA60 band for Sentinel-2 cloud masking 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid NDSI range is -1 to 1 - Zero or negative NDSI is valid (means no snow) - Need to check for: empty collections (C1), no valid pixels after masking (C2), invalid results (C3) - Compare mean NDSI: if 2020 < 2019, answer A; else B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Mount Fuji location const fuji = ee.Geometry.Point([138.73, 35.36]).buffer(5000); // 5km radius // Date ranges const date2019 = ['2019-12-01', '2019-12-31']; const date2020 = ['2020-12-01', '2020-12-31']; // Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Function to calculate NDSI function addNDSI(image) { const ndsi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('NDSI'); return image.addBands(ndsi); } // Get Sentinel-2 collections let col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(fuji) .filterDate(date2019[0], date2019[1]) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNDSI); let col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(fuji) .filterDate(date2020[0], date2020[1]) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNDSI); const size2019 = await col2019.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = await col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}`); console.log(`2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2019 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or both periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Create median composites const img2019 = col2019.median(); const img2020 = col2020.median(); // Check valid pixel counts const count2019 = await img2019.select('NDSI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: fuji, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI').getInfo(); const count2020 = await img2020.select('NDSI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: fuji, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI').getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Valid pixels: ${count2019}`); console.log(`2020 Valid pixels: ${count2020}`); if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after cloud masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate mean NDSI const ndsi2019 = await img2019.select('NDSI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: fuji, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI').getInfo(); const ndsi2020 = await img2020.select('NDSI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: fuji, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI').getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Mean NDSI: ${ndsi2019?.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`2020 Mean NDSI: ${ndsi2020?.toFixed(3)}`); // Validate results if (ndsi2019 === null || ndsi2020 === null || isNaN(ndsi2019) || isNaN(ndsi2020) || ndsi2019 < -1 || ndsi2019 > 1 || ndsi2020 < -1 || ndsi2020 > 1) { console.log("Invalid NDSI values."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare and answer if (ndsi2020 < ndsi2019) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
